Two committed, append-only `hh-site-publication/1` records — one per

both gated on manifest row 317 GATE-G31 and pointing at its readout:

| record | phase | pages | pinned inputs |
|---|---|---|---|
| `docs/results/publication/phase-3-2026-11-19.json` | phase-3 | `/phase-3/` | `p3-l1` `bdbb0bc9…63218`, `p3-l2` `01db3d7f…14415`, `p3-l3` `9869c904…e02d2` |
| `docs/results/publication/phase-4-2026-11-19.json` | phase-4 | `/phase-4/` | `p4-fp` `5c425c1a…7cecd` |

`inputs_digest` recomputed by R6.6's validator:
phase-3 `sha256:1ecaf168ab5ca9ac…`, phase-4 `sha256:937aa94c7b0012aa…`.

## Generator/site changes consumed by the records

- `scripts/site/hhsite/publication.py` — `PHASE_GATES` maps phase-3
  and phase-4 → GATE-G31 (its verbatim scope was "phase-3/4 first-pass
  pages"). The base's premature `phase-2 → GATE-G31` entry is
  **removed**: GATE-G31 decided no phase-2 publication, so a future
  phase-2 record now fails closed (`no publication gate in the
  manifest`) until its own operator decision.
- `scripts/site/hhsite/sitepages.py` — `p3_live`/`p4_live` admit the
  public profile when a committed record pins the phase (`published`
  set), matching REQ-XF-129/REQ-XH-018; the home tile for a published
  first-pass phase stamps `first pass — withheld` /
  `published — GATE-G31` (never "Available").
- `scripts/check-site.sh` — new leg: a phase pinned by a record that
  still renders `publication gate pending` fails (catches record/site
  disagreement in either direction).
- `scripts/check-position.sh` — the publication-card leg generalizes:
  `[results-site]` (any record), `[hir-parity]` (phase-3 record),
  `[config-sweep]` (phase-4 record) each must carry the
  "internal record; not outside-verified" cap, link a committed
  record and name the site URL; `Available` requires the matching
  phase's record to exist.
- `scripts/ci/test-check-position.sh` — mutations (n)–(p): promoted
  card, lost record link, and `Available` with the phase-3 record
  removed — all expected-fail, all verified.
- `scripts/site/tests/test_phase2.py`, `test_phase34.py` — fixture
  renders carry no publications (`pubs = []`): the committed records
  pin the real input set, and a fixture cfg the records do not pin is
  refused (REQ-XF-129) — now asserted by the `public-refusal` leg.
- `scripts/site/tests/golden/phase3-withheld-l1.html` — regenerated
  (`--write-golden`). The base golden drifted at `be6315b2` (verified
  by stashing): the renderer's `class="num"` marker on three
  `kl_report` numeric members post-dated the snapshot. Diff is exactly
  three `class="num"` additions; no content change.
